title: A part sale's labor cells show a dash in the PDF and are blank in the CSV
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have a part sale for that customer with Sales Representative set to that staff member and one part at $80.00, and invoice it today.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
custom_steps:
1. Export the CSV and find the part sale's row.
  2. Export the PDF and find the same row.
  3. Export the Expanded CSV and find the part sale's row.
  4. Export the Expanded PDF and find the same row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin are empty cells, not 0.00.

Step 2:

  • Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin show a dash, not 0.00 or $0.00.

Step 3:

  • Every labor and hours cell of the row is empty, not 0.00.

Step 4:

  • Every labor and hours cell of the row shows a dash, not 0.00 or $0.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R15b: “On a Part Sales row, Labor Delta, Labor Invoiced and Labor Margin, and the labor and hours cells of the Expanded downloads, show a dash on screen and in the PDF and are blank in the CSV. A part sale has no labor, so these columns don't apply to it.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 39: “39. (a) A dash on screen and in the PDF, and an empty cell in the CSV, as the design shows. A part sale has no labor, so the labor columns don't apply to it; it's the same rule as answers 24 and 25. This changes today's 0.00 / $0.00, so it's now listed under Release day. New S5-R15b, PRD v11.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
